source_question: 大标题：Jointly Build the Best FBB Experience in Ecuador Accelerating FTTH Business Success。我现在做的是 take-up-rate 提升专题主打材料，这里应该主要写用户发展。加速用户发展，促进 FTTH 商业成功怎么样？
core: Accelerate subscriber growth to drive FTTH business success.
meaning_cn: 加速用户增长，推动 FTTH 商业成功。
explanation_cn: 用于 PPT 主标题或行动方向。subscriber growth 比 user development 更准确地表达运营商用户规模增长；to drive 清楚表达“通过前者推动后者”的目的关系，也比并列使用 accelerate 和 promote 更自然。标题中可写为 Accelerate Subscriber Growth to Drive FTTH Business Success。
source_sentence: 加速用户发展，促进 FTTH 商业成功

examples.en: Accelerate subscriber growth to drive FTTH business success.
examples.cn: 加速用户增长，推动 FTTH 商业成功。

examples.en: Expand fiber coverage to accelerate subscriber growth.
examples.cn: 扩大光纤覆盖，加快用户增长。

examples.en: A better customer experience can support long-term FTTH business success.
examples.cn: 更好的客户体验可以支撑长期 FTTH 商业成功。

pronunciation.text: Accelerate subscriber growth to drive FTTH business success.
pronunciation.hint_cn: Accelerate、subscriber growth、drive 和 business success 承担主要信息重音；FTTH 可逐字母读。

source_question: It's OK. Manager has help me
core: It's okay. My manager has helped me.
meaning_cn: 没关系，我的经理已经帮我处理了。
explanation_cn: has help 不符合现在完成时结构，应使用过去分词 has helped。manager 在这里通常需要限定词，如 my manager。It's okay 比 It's OK 更适合作为普通句子书写；若只陈述过去一次已完成的帮助，也可以说 My manager helped me。
source_sentence: It's OK. Manager has help me

examples.en: It's okay. My manager has helped me.
examples.cn: 没关系，我的经理已经帮我处理了。

examples.en: Don't worry. My colleague has already helped me with it.
examples.cn: 别担心，我的同事已经帮我处理这件事了。

examples.en: The issue has been resolved with my manager's help.
examples.cn: 在我经理的帮助下，这个问题已经解决了。

pronunciation.text: It's okay. My manager has helped me.
pronunciation.hint_cn: okay、manager 和 helped 承担主要信息重音；has 在自然口语中通常弱读。
